description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLicenseDao class, which handles database operations related to EmployeeLicense entities in an HR management system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee licenses, as well as fetching allowed licenses for employees.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for EmployeeLicense entity, providing CRUD and search functionalities tailored for employee licenses.

methods.name: saveEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeLicense entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeLicense entity based on employee number and license ID.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeLicenses
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeLicense entries for a given employee based on provided license IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Searches for EmployeeLicense entities based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeLicensesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of EmployeeLicense entities matching search criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedLicenses
methods.description: Fetches licenses not assigned to a specific employee, possibly for assignment purposes.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedLicensesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of available licenses not assigned to a specific employee.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeLicensesPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for searching EmployeeLicense entities with applied filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedLicensesPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator for licenses not assigned to an employee, supporting filtering and sorting.
